question: Why do people attain the supreme in different ways?
premises: One person digging a well feels accomplished only when water is reached.
Another is satisfied with water already at hand.
The attainment of the supreme likewise follows varied ways.
inference: The method of attaining the supreme differs according to readiness and circumstance.
plain_english: Just as one who sets out to dig a well feels accomplished only when water is reached, while another is satisfied with water already in hand, so the way of attaining the supreme is varied.
